issues.reason: The whenever pattern keys the response on the trigger OCCURRENCE - "Every time the bell rings" makes the minted bark (sk_bark $x) a function of the ring-event variable - and a dependent existential must be "a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it", so terms keyed on the stone alone mint one growth per stone and then place that single event During two distinct submersions, asserting content the text does not state.

defect_summary: The compliant form makes the minted terms functions of the trigger event as well - (sk_grow $x $e) and (sk_salt_bloom $x $e), or of $e alone since the Patient premise determines the stone - so each submersion mints its own growth event and its own bloom witness.
notes: The rest of the routing is right: bare "when" with indefinite/generic participants takes the whenever rule at 1.0/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase, "that stone" binds the premise variable, Location rides the grow event only (never LocatedIn on the bloom), and both compound head genera are present. The reviewer's Patient-vs-Theme remark on the passive was filed as a note, not an issue, and is a defensible judgment call either way.
